assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION FROM T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION ON T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE.ID_MOVIE WHERE T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE.ID_GENRE = 16 ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 15
